story:
One pair of thin gold hoops and a little pile of donut beads beside them: hot pink, cherry red, sunny yellow, turquoise, a black-and-white marble.

The bead slides on and off the hoop, so the earrings change with whatever you are wearing.
socialCaption: Swap donut hoops: one pair of hoops, a handful of bead colors. Mix and match any colors.
name: Swap Donut Hoops
materials: Gold-tone wire hoops, colorful donut beads
adBody: One pair of gold hoops plus colorful donut beads that slide on and off. Change the color with the outfit.

name: Swap Pumpkin Hoops
materials: Gold-tone wire hoops, fluted melon beads with gold stripes
story:
The hoop opens and the bead slides off, so one pair of hoops can be orange today and sky blue tomorrow. I keep the beads in a row on the felt: orange, hot pink, lime, purple, pink, sky blue, green, red, cream.

Start with one color or take the whole set.
adHeadline: Change the bead, change the day
adBody: Gold hoops with wired, gold-capped pumpkin beads in many colors. Swap beads anytime.
socialCaption: Swap hoops with nine bead colors waiting. The five-color set is the one most people pick.

story:
The Tibetan beads are the heavy, detailed kind: brass wrapped in twisted wire, set with turquoise and coral. On a thin gold hoop, one bead is enough.

They slide off like the other swap beads, so one pair of hoops can carry them all.
socialCaption: Swap Tibetan hoops: handcrafted brass beads with turquoise and coral, on gold hoops you can change.
name: Swap Tibetan Hoops
materials: Gold-tone wire hoops, Tibetan brass beads with turquoise and coral inlay
adBody: Gold hoops with handcrafted Tibetan brass beads inlaid with turquoise & coral.
altText: A young woman with a dark low bun in a mustard top, in profile against a terracotta wall, wearing a gold hoop with a turquoise Tibetan bead at the bottom.

name: Single Flower Drops
materials: Enamel flower charms, gold-tone metal, gold french hooks
story:
One flower on one hook. I lay the charms out on the black felt in every color I have, red daisies, green blossoms, violet petals with a yellow heart, and let the pair choose itself.

They are the smallest thing I make and the easiest to wear. A little color at the ear, nothing more.
adBody: Gold hook earrings with one enamel flower charm. Light, everyday wear.
socialCaption: The single drops, laid out on the felt. Pick a color; each pair is one small flower on a gold hook.

name: Flower Charm Hoops
materials: Gold-tone wire hoops, interchangeable enamel flower charms
story:
Thin gold hoops, and a handful of flower charms that slide on and off. Pink blossom today, a yellow one tomorrow, a violet four-petal flower or a green daisy when the mood changes.

One pair of hoops, a different flower whenever you like. These are the ones people ask about.
adBody: Gold hoops with swappable enamel flower charms. Pick today’s flower.
socialCaption: Flower charm hoops: one pair of gold hoops, and the charms change. Pink, yellow, violet, green, pick one.

name: Pumpkin Bead Drops
materials: Fluted melon beads with gold stripes, gold filigree caps, gold french hooks
story:
A round fluted bead between two gold filigree caps, so it hangs like a small lantern. I make them in green, red, orange, and cream, and every bead has its own gold lines running top to bottom.

The orange ones always go first in the fall.
adHeadline: A small lantern at the ear
adBody: Gold hooks with a ribbed pumpkin bead between filigree gold caps.
socialCaption: Pumpkin bead drops in green, red, orange, and cream. Gold caps top and bottom, gold hook.

story:
One bead, wire-wrapped into a loop by hand. It hangs from a fine chain at the collarbone, or slides onto your swap hoops.

Small enough to forget about, until the light catches the gold.
socialCaption: Tibetan bead pendants: handcrafted brass and turquoise. Wear it on a chain or on your swap hoops.

name: Tibetan Bead Drop Earrings
materials: Tibetan-style beads with turquoise and coral inlay, gold-tone wire
story:
The beads are the heavy, detailed kind: dark centers wrapped in twisted gold wire, set with turquoise and coral. I wire-wrap each one into a loop by hand so it hangs cleanly from the hook.

One is all blue-green stones in a gold cage. One has red and turquoise dots between gold swirls. Both feel old in the hand.
adBody: Gold hooks with a statement Tibetan brass bead, turquoise & coral inlay.
socialCaption: Tibetan bead drops, wrapped this week. Turquoise, coral, and a lot of twisted gold.
